purpose: Dated capability candidates for project-specific comparison; never installation authority.

entries.name: Base UI
best_for: React interfaces needing unstyled accessible primitives
avoid_when: A native element or existing project primitive meets the requirement
entries.notes: Version and release were verified from the official 1.8.0 release page on 2026-09-05; npm lifecycle scripts remain unverified.

entries.name: Radix UI Primitives
best_for: Complex widgets where correctness is expensive to reproduce
avoid_when: A native element or existing project primitive meets the requirement
entries.notes: Exact publication date and npm lifecycle scripts were not verified.

entries.name: React Aria Components
best_for: React applications needing broad accessible behaviour and internationalisation
avoid_when: The requirement is a simple native control or the project does not use React
entries.notes: react-aria-components and react-aria are different packages; exact publication date and lifecycle scripts remain unverified.

entries.name: shadcn/ui
best_for: Projects that explicitly accept generated source and dependency changes
avoid_when: The generated house conventions conflict with the approved direction
entries.acquisition: CLI that writes source/configuration and may install dependencies
entries.design_authority: none; generated source must be reconciled with DESIGN.md
entries.notes: The apply flow may overwrite preset configuration. Treat all CLI actions as G2-bound and inspect before execution.

entries.name: Tailwind Plus
best_for: Licensed projects that deliberately choose its source components
avoid_when: Redistribution, template-building, or an incompatible project visual language
entries.resolved_revision: no public product version; Elements runtime 1.0.22
entries.acquisition: Paid source archive; optional npm or CDN runtime
entries.design_authority: external source only; project remains responsible for art direction
entries.notes: Do not vendor or redistribute. Reverify entitlement and exact licence scope at G2.

entries.name: Lieflat Charts
entries.acquisition: Repository with skills, scripts, and remote install instructions
entries.notes: No immutable release was verified. Do not install or treat floating main as a stable capability.
